issuer: the Office of Motor Vehicles of the Department of Public Safety of American Samoa (the Commissioner of Public Safety)
note: Read 2026-10-30 in the American Samoa Code Annotated as the American Samoa Bar Association publishes it (asbar.org, 'Updated Annotated Code by Title (as of August 2021)'), Title 22, chapter 02 (sections 22.0202 to 22.0209 saved by wave 12's agent B; 22.0205 saved today). Only two licences are issued, provisional and private (22.0202). A provisional licence goes to anyone who doesn't qualify for a private one, and only from 18 (22.0205(g)(1)); it expires when its holder has completed 2 years' experience as a provisional driver, who is then eligible for a private licence (22.0209(b)). The private licence's age is built from those stages, 18 and 2 years, 20 (a reading to check: 22.0204(a) lets someone who has completed an approved driver's education course have an 'operator's license' at 16, a section from the same 1978 law, PL 15-108, as 22.0205(g)'s 18, and the Code doesn't say which licence that is; someone who already qualifies for a private licence, such as a holder of another jurisdiction's licence under 22.0204(g), isn't shown an age). The private licence expires 3 years from its issue (22.0209(a)) and its fee is $12 (22.0208(a)(1), '3-year motor vehicle Private driver license'); the provisional's is $9. Licences are applied for to the Commissioner (Public Safety, 22.0101(6); 22.0207) at the Office of Motor Vehicles (22.0204). The US dollar is American Samoa's currency.

sources.title: A.S.C.A. 22.0202 Types of licenses-Learner’s permit
sources.said: Only 2 types of driver’s licenses shall be issued in American Samoa: a provisional driver’s license and a private driver’s license.

sources.title: A.S.C.A. 22.0205 Learner’s permit
sources.said: Any person, regardless of previous driving experience, who does not qualify for a private driver’s license, shall be licensed to drive in American Samoa as a provisional driver; provided, that no provisional driver’s license shall be issued to any person unless he: (1) is 18 years of age or more;

sources.title: A.S.C.A. 22.0209 Expiration and renewal of driver’s license
sources.said: All private driver’s licenses shall expire 3 years from the date of issue. ... A provisional driver’s license shall expire when the licensee has completed 2 years’ experience as a provisional driver, excluding any time during which the license was suspended. At the time of expiration, the provisional licensee shall be eligible for a private driver’s license.

sources.title: A.S.C.A. 22.0208 License fees
sources.said: (1) 3-year motor vehicle Private driver license, $12.00; ... (4) Provisional driver license, $9.00;

sources.title: A.S.C.A. 22.0204 Operator’s license
sources.said: No person may be permitted to obtain an operator’s license before reaching the age of 18 unless he has successfully completed an approved course in driver’s education. Persons who have successfully completed an approved course in driver’s education may obtain their operator’s license at age 16. ... producing that license for inspection at the Office of Motor Vehicles

sources.title: A.S.C.A. 22.0207 License application-Issuance and contents-Fees
sources.said: Application for a driver’s license shall be made to the Commissioner on such forms as are prescribed by the Commissioner.

sources.title: A.S.C.A. 22.0101 Definitions
sources.said: “Commissioner” means the Commissioner of Public Safety in American Samoa.
